title: QB AIMBOT | FOOTBALL MAGNETS | BEST SCRIPT FF3
features:
THROWING
QB Aimbot
- Quarterback Aimbot that aims and throws for you
- Anti Out Of Bounds
- Target mode: Mouse, Camera or Most Open
- Aim engine: new throw maths or Classic
- Ping Compensation and Lane Check
- Auto Angle, Auto Throw Type and Auto Power
- High Power Mode and Always 95 Power
- Lead Multiplier, Lead Trim, Height Trim
- Separate leads for Jump, Dime, Mag, Bullet, Fade and Dive throws
- Catch Height
- Defender Highlight, UI cards, target switch speed
- Movable throw HUD with size and position, Mobile UI
- Auto Get QB
Keybinds
- Cycle throw type, jump straight to Jump, Dime, Mag or Bullet
- Lock On Target, Angle Up and Down, Power Up and Down
Smart Fit
- Lock a target, T To Throw, mobile LOCK and THROW buttons
- Target Highlight, Flash Defenders, Ignore Defenders
- Safety margin min and max, bounds tolerance, field settings
Reach and Timing
- Receiver and defender horizontal and vertical reach
- Reaction time and dive reaction sliders

CATCHING
Reach
- Football Magnets with offense and defense reach, delay, activation distance and visualizer
- Auto Catch
Magnets
- Mag Enhancers with min and max angle, method and visualizer
- Pull Vector with range, power and cooldown

DEFENSE
Tackling
- Tackle Extender with reach and delay
- Click Tackle Teleport with distance and cooldown
Rushing
- Auto Rush with prediction, keep rushing after the throw, quick resume and smart move direction
- Walk to line of scrimmage, only behind the line, toggle key, mobile button and notifications
- Visualizer: interception point, lines from you and the carrier, line width
- Rush Assist: look ahead, his path, distance
- Rush timing: reaction time, random factor and random delay
Coverage
- Swat Reach and swat delay
- Auto Guard with cover method, lock, coverage delay, PR yards and horizontal offset
- Receiver highlight, toggle key, mobile button and notifications

PLAYER
Movement
- JumpPower, air jump power and dive power
- Quick TP with key and distance
Assist
- Angle Enhancer with window, S check and indicator
- Boost Enhancer with strength, delay, air only and boost range
- Angle strength with chance range
Blocking
- Block Extender with lateral, forward and vertical reach and visualizer
- Block Modifier with pushback and chance range

VISUALS
- Highlight Ball and Remove Ball Trail
- Line To Ball with distance, width, style and only while live
- Ball trajectory with trajectory type
- Time of day, big head size and transparency, replay FPS

MISC
- Server hop
